scope: current workspace database implementation with isolated temporary SQLite databases
method: initialize a new database, bulk-seed terminal jobs, time the UI summary query, list the newest 500 jobs, and clear terminal history
interpretation: The measured summary and 500-row list queries are not a current P1 bottleneck at these data sizes.
Clearing 10000 terminal rows approaches one 50 ms UI-frame budget and remains a low-frequency main-thread risk.
Bulk seeding is fixture setup and is not part of normal UI timing.
